verdict.rationale: Obsidian Publish is a first-party hosted service that publishes notes as a wiki, knowledge base or digital garden. You select notes and press Publish inside the app, and they are hosted at publish.obsidian.md/your-site or on a custom domain. Internal linking is documented for the vault, but the docs here do not explicitly say links stay working and browsable on the published site. missing for 10: explicit evidence that internal links and navigation work on published sites, independent or hands-on corroboration of Publish.
